dct_description_sm: The Eionet priority data flows identify a set of agreed, stable, well-defined objectives to provide a focus for countries when they are putting procedures in place for regular reporting. The objective is to encourage countries towards better performance through comptition amicale concentrating on praise for achievements rather than blame for failures.  Eionet aims to provide timely and quality-assured data, information and expertise for assessing the state of the environment in Europe and the pressures acting upon it. This enables policy-makers to decide on appropriate measures for protecting the environment at national and European level and to monitor the effectiveness of policies and measures implemented.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Policy
dct_title_s: European Environment Information and Observation Network (Eionet) priority data flows
